_doc: Delays of the vacuum-tube cells for gate-level simulation, in ns.
rtl/run/vtube_sdf.py turns this into SDF for the specify paths of vtube_cells.v
(synth_sim.sh -t, doc/vtube_sdf_timing.md). iopath: one value, or [rise, fall].
setuphold: D before / after the capturing clock edge (rising; falling for DFF_J2N16).
Estimates: 150 ns per tube stage; RELAY_2CO contacts pass signals with no delay.
NOT_N16, NOR2_N16, NOR4_N16, NAND2_J2, A1OOI_N16J2, A2OOI_J2, LATCH_J2N16, DFF_J2N16: SPICE at fanout 6, not measured,
to the next stage's thresholds: a falling output to 92 V, a rising one to 118 V (owner, 2026-10-29;
tools/spice/threshold_delays.py). QN arcs are the Q arcs with rise and fall swapped.
BUF_N16, OR2_N16, OR4_N16 (cathode followers, LV output): input grid -5 V -> Y -5 V at fanout 6, where the next
DFFRN/DFFSN: RN/SN -> forced output 80 ns, the other output 450 ns (tools/spice/dffr_sweep.py async).
fanout: the arc at fanout 2 / 6 / 10 grids as a ratio to the value above (output rise / fall), from the
fanout tables of the cell pages (sch/logic/<CELL>/README.md); where a page gives only 2 and 10, 6 is their
mean. Cells without it are taken as fanout-independent. rtl/run/vtube_liberty.py builds the NLDM tables of
To be replaced by simulated (SPICE) and measured values, OPEN-013/014.

masked.why: Cathode readings latched every Clk. A write or a reset line ends at any moment, so they change asynchronously; only the cycle that accepts an operation reads them (DekatronCounter, doc/vtube_sdf_timing.md §3.5).
